source.title: Puzzle landed in competitor's lap and then on floor in solved state
source.content:
At the end of a competitor's solve, the puzzle landed on the competitor's lap briefly, and then fell onto the floor in a solved state.

Upon discussion with the delegate, the WRC deemed that it was likely that the cube bounced off the competitor right away. Thus, by regulation [A6e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#A6e2)'s exception, it was concluded to not apply a penalty to this solve.

translation.title: 魔方短暂落到腿上，随后以已还原状态掉到地上
translation.content:
选手还原结束时，魔方短暂落在腿上，随后以已还原状态掉到地上。

与代表讨论后，WRC 认为魔方很可能立即从选手身上弹开，因此依据 [A6e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#A6e2) 的例外，不予处罚。
